note: Formula-side guardrail. These convert a product to an OTC drug by composition, independent of what the copy says. Checked at formulation review, not only at copy review. Not legal advice.

actives.reason: OTC anti-dandruff monograph active. Presence alone makes the product a drug.
OTC monograph active for dandruff/seborrheic dermatitis/psoriasis.
Antifungal drug. Prescription or OTC drug depending on strength.
OTC monograph active when used as a dandruff active. If sourced only as a trace component of another material, document the distinction in COMPLIANCE.md before proceeding.
Permitted as a cosmetic exfoliant below 1.8%. At or above 1.8% it is an OTC monograph active and the product becomes a drug.
actives.additionalRisk: Below 1.8% it is still a REVIEW item for Yuuki specifically: combined with scalp positioning, salicylic acid invites the dandruff/seborrheic reading even without a claim.
actives.requires: Explicit sign-off note recorded in COMPLIANCE.md, naming the SKU, the concentration, and who approved it.

reviewPolicy.BLOCK: Do not formulate. No sign-off available at cosmetic status.
reviewPolicy.REVIEW: Permitted only with a dated sign-off note in COMPLIANCE.md. Absence of that note is treated as a failure.
